name: genius-star-web
description: Web edition of The Genius Star puzzle game with accounts, history and multiplayer lobbies.

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of ['js/geometry','js/pieces','js/dice','js/solver','js/backend','js/game','js/account','js/lobby','api/config','tools/serve','tools/verify-all-rolls']) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', f + '.js'], {stdio:'inherit'}); console.log('syntax ok')"
